freight_scope: Local cereal support envelope: path eligibility and finite food/storage are enforced; cargo capacity is bounded above by available annual grain rather than the earlier arbitrary 5-tonne/site/bin prototype. No maritime or long-distance grain imports, crew/draft budgets or measured freight throughput is inferred.
request_scope: 7.5% of legacy market-served people, with a 100-person minimum request, is a reference civilian demand scenario, not an empirically validated city-size model. The previous size/market-access failure remains a negative control. Food can only reduce this request; unused surplus does not invent residents.
institution_scope: Declared resident cohort reserved only where at least 50 requested civilians can coexist in the same repeating food budget. Known affiliation or generated-site claim hypothesis supplies an actor, not evidence of actual staff or sovereignty. Unknown affiliation remains unscored for political reach.
population_scope: Alternative cereal-dependent settlement scenario at existing marked/proposed nodes, not extra people added to farming, FORGE, pastoral or census totals. Generated nodes retain their administrative/market candidate scope; unclaimed land and mobile communities are not assigned empty-land scores.
